paragraphs: Hillel ben Gamliel — see his entry.

Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel — [Kiddushin, chapter 3, mishnah 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Kiddushin.3.4). Yehuda ben Gamliel is Rabbi Yehuda Nesiah, and there were three of them, as explained in their entries.
Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel — there were two of them; see their entries.

notes.text: Hyman distinguishes three bearers of the Yehudah Nasi name and two of Shimon ben Gamliel; these are the notice’s own enumerations.

In this passage the Bavli gives Isi ben Gamliel as one of several names for Isi ben Akavya. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=441&lang=en) also directs readers to Isi ben Akavya.
